title: 6633: Log warning for blocks exceeding column width
body:
## :bookmark_tabs: Summary

This PR introduces a validation check and corresponding warning when a block's width exceeds the configured number of columns. 
Currently, blocks that span beyond the available column count cause render unexpected spaces without clear feedback to the user.

Resolves #6633

comments.author: copilot-pull-request-reviewer
comments.body:
Enhance the error message to include both the block's actual width and the configured column width for clearer debugging, e.g. `Block ${block.id} width ${block.widthInColumns} exceeds configured column width ${column}`.
```suggestion
      throw new Error(`Block ${block.id} width ${block.widthInColumns} exceeds configured column width ${column}`);
```

review_threads.actionability_reasoning: Suggests a specific code change to enhance the error message with additional context (actual width and configured column width).

comments.author: aloisklink
comments.body:
**issue(probably blocking)**: This breaks existing `block-beta` diagrams, which I'm not really a big fan of. Since the diagram has a `-beta` tag, I think it's acceptable, but if we can avoid it, I'd recommend it!

**suggestion**: Could we maybe change this to logging a warning instead?

comments.author: aloisklink
comments.body: Maybe we could also change the code so that we still show the block "overflowing" the column, but the extra empty rows are removed as well :thinking:

review_threads.actionability_reasoning: Identifies a breaking change concern and suggests changing the implementation from throwing an error to logging a warning instead.

comments.author: aloisklink
comments.body:
